gaps: Automatic external-client merges lacked human authority under the unchanged manual merge policy.
The Portable migration admitted active fixed review sets even though confirmed canon requires fresh combined review for active tasks and sealed-only upgrade migration.
The ten retained client failures were promised as binding but their exact ownership rows existed only in a historical non-authoritative graph.
The Integration evidence contract required an exact ordered six-label platform report without naming those labels in an authoritative artifact.
The promised replacement decomposition and First task plan still carried stale post-integration decision identities and a nonexistent Decision 0068 model-policy path.
Lean recorded an unapproved partition capability even though the confirmed grill contract forbids partitioning.
The multi-gate design-review wording had no executable protocol for independent digest-bound publication.
A later coordinator could not recover an abandoned required ordinary-chat question from the proposed transfer state.
Adding a pull-request trigger to the write-authorized harness-health workflow would permit untrusted PR activity to push an upgrade branch or create a PR.
resolutions: The amended plan limits the prior one-time client authorization to branch, push, and PR creation, retains each external repository human merge gate, and starts the next client only after observing and verifying the human merge.

The amended plan excludes every active or otherwise unmarked fixed set, requires its fresh ordinary combined review against current task state, and lets Portable inventory and migrate only proof bound to immutable task markers.
The amended plan now contains the binding ten-row client-failure table with each symptom, exact owner, source seams, and acceptance obligation.

The amended plan names the exact six labels in order: native-cli-macos, native-desktop-macos, native-cli-linux-ubuntu-24.04-x64, native-desktop-linux-ubuntu-24.04-x64, native-cli-windows, and native-desktop-windows.

The transition now names the exact 0067/0068/0069/0070/0072/0073 meanings without spelling the obsolete phantom path, and the corrected decomposition and task-plan candidates replace every stale identity before implementation.

The amended plan keeps one complete input and one cold read per grill gate, explicitly forbids partitioning, and assigns no partition capability to Lean; the matching decomposition candidate removes it.
The amended plan requires one complete assessment and independently digest-bound record per gate through the existing one-gate launcher.

Shared now uses the existing story-scoped .factory/signals.jsonl blocked signal before a required ordinary-chat question; session start, forge next, and pr_ready expose or block on an unresolved signal, so abandonment is recoverable without a chat ledger.
Only factory-scaffold keeps a pull-request trigger and its existing main push; harness-health receives no pull-request trigger and keeps mutation on its existing trusted main push/manual dispatch.

rounds.question: When CI requires a PR, which delivery rule should Forge use?
What should happen when any required question exchange for the story is still open?

The refreshed exact plan also removes the last literal phantom decision reference that the structural checker correctly treated as a live citation, while preserving the approved transition semantics.
